gen-gf-bellota-gf-telex: Bellota traces every stroke at one stylus width, and its s lets the ends hang far from the spine. Telex does the quieter work, its curvy letters loose and unclamped.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tenor-sans: Distinctive and commanding, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, every stroke traced at one stylus width. Tenor Sans carries paragraphs smoothly, its thin strokes barely lighter than thick.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tirra: Bellota draws horizontals and verticals with the same stylus width, its s ends hanging far from the spine. Tirra settles in beneath it, a low-contrast sans with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-titillium-web: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, with horizontals and verticals drawn at one stylus width. Titillium Web adds approachable, low-contrast text with its stroke ends set far apart.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tomorrow: Bellota sketches every letter like a pencil that never presses harder. It owns the far-swinging s ends, while Tomorrow, a low-contrast sans, is best at bowls that open like a cupped palm.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-trispace: An s with ends hanging far from the spine marks Bellota, whose strokes show zero contrast throughout. Trispace sits beside it with sparse, widely set letters and curves opening outward.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Every stroke in Bellota is traced at one stylus width, and its s lets its ends hang far from the spine. Tsukimi Rounded, a plain sans, sits beside it, round and parallel-edged.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tuffy: Tuffy writes like a pencil that never presses harder, with a widely parted s. Tuffy stays out of the way under Bellota, whose own s hangs its ends far from the spine.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-urbanist: Contemporary and professional, Urbanist writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. And Bellota, with its far-hanging s and one stylus width, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-varela: Bellota is the showpiece here, its s hanging its ends far from the spine in strokes traced at one stylus width. Varela handles text, its t sharing one width across crossbar and stem.
